candidate_semantics: first validation event per user, temporal available full catalog, FIT-seen mask
early_stopping: none; identical fixed epoch cap for all comparable neural trials
gpu_time_exceed_action: HOLD and record, never CPU fallback or silent trial omission
precision: BF16 autocast where existing model path qualified; FP32 accumulation and exact ranking
selection_rule: Preserve all trial outcomes. Shortlist by validation NDCG@20 overall, controlled-cold and warm FIT separately; do not select a single finalist or comparator before seed qualification and QUALIFICATION evidence. Exclude an ID-only model as sole cold comparator.
failure_rule: Record failure, OOM, elapsed GPU time, and reason under its distinct trial ID; no replacement trial without a protocol decision made before protected access.
